title: India and Armenia Sign MoU on Defence Innovation
summary: India and Armenia signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in Yerevan on 17 August 2026 for cooperation in defence research, development, innovation, and joint production. India’s Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh signed the agreement ...

blocks.content: India and Armenia signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in Yerevan on 17 August 2026 for cooperation in defence research, development, innovation, and joint production. India’s Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh signed the agreement during a two-day official visit that began on 16 August 2026.

items: Yerevan is the capital and largest city of Armenia.
The Akash system is an Indian surface-to-air missile system used for air defence.
Pinaka is an Indian multi-barrel rocket launcher system developed for the Indian Army.
ATAGS stands for Advanced Towed Artillery Gun System, which is an Indian artillery platform.
